name: Concept art -> 3D pipeline
whatItIs: GPT asset concept (Meshy-friendly template, approved concepts as style references) -> user approval -> Meshy image-to-3D using that exact image -> Blender headless cleanup (scale, pivot, decimate to poly budget, palette snap, LODs, GLB).
gotchas: Live API calls not yet exercised end to end; dry runs and mocked requests are tested.
Non-humanoid rigging is a known weak spot.
